user.title: Pulse
user.description: Pulse found {count} battery-powered devices. It only listens to what they send anyway and never queries them, so it costs no battery. Everything else is set up in the Pulse panel.

device_failed.title: {name} isn't responding
device_failed.description:
{reason}

Usually the battery is empty. After replacing it, choose “Battery replaced” in Pulse (sidebar) or wait until the device reports again. This notice then disappears by itself.

mark_replaced.name: Battery replaced
mark_replaced.description: Records a battery change for a device.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device whose battery was replaced.

snooze.name: Postpone reminder
snooze.description: No notifications for a device for a while.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long to stay quiet. 0 cancels a postponement.

ignore.name: Ignore device
ignore.description: Pulse stops monitoring a device (or resumes).

send_test.name: Send test notification
send_test.description: Sends a test notification to all Pulse recipients.
